## ⚠️ 只派两条路里的**第二条**,第一条留给裁决 —— 分开的理由不是省事

卡写着「待裁 两条路,都动已发布面,所以只立卡」。**两条不是一类**,把它们绑在一起才是错的:

| | 路 | 类别 | 本轮 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | 顶层 `fields` 遇到解析不出名字的成员时发具名 `console.warn` | **行为改动** —— 新增一条运行期输出 | ⛔ **不派**,待裁 |
| **2** | 给注册面的 `fields` 补 description,写明成员是裸字段名、以及它与 `sections[].fields` 的区别 | **说明书与实现脱节** | ✅ **本轮** |

路 2 由一条**已在案的维护者裁定**覆盖 —— **objectstack#17031**,标题即结论「说明书与实现脱节的卡默认改文档,⛔ 不进决策箱」:

> 所有这种文档错的都应该改文档,没有什么好决裁的,这个应该写入技能。

⇒ 顶层 `fields` 的实现行为**没有争议**(它读裸名,`{ name }` 被容忍,别的静默跳过),争议只在于「要不要额外喊一声」。**描述掉队那一半方向无可争议**;⛔ 路 1 是另一回事,它给一个已发布组件加运行期输出,不是文档修复。

⭐ 而且路 2 单独就有真实价值:卡自己说得很清楚 —— 注册声明是 `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' }`,**没有 `of`、没有 description**;spec 那边是 `z.array(z.unknown())`,description 只有一句「Limit/order the fields shown」。⇒ **作者今天在任何授权面上都读不到「顶层 `fields` 和 `sections[].fields` 词汇不同」这件事。**补上它,那个静默丢弃就从「无从得知」变成「写之前能读到」。

## 范围

`packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`(或注册 `inputs` 所在处)顶层 `fields` 条目的 `description`:成员是**裸字段名**;⛔ 不是 `sections[].fields` 接受的 spec `FormFieldSchema` 对象;把 `{ field: 'note', colSpan: 2 }` 写在这里会被**静默跳过**。

⛔ **不要做的,卡里点名禁止,本席重申**:

> ⛔ **不要**做的:在顶层读点加一条 `?? f.field` 的宽容回退。那正是 AGENTS.md #0.1 禁止的第二方言,它会把「一个词两套词汇」固化成契约,而不是把它消掉。

⇒ ⛔ 不加回退、⛔ 不加 `console.warn`、⛔ 不动 `normalizeSectionField` 或 `buildFlatFields`。**本轮只动描述文字。**

⚠️ 已有探针:`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormFieldsMembers-8071.test.tsx` 第 4、5 行两个方向都钉住了,并用同一条目在 section 里**确实渲染**作为活对照。**先跑它、记下测试数**;⛔ 本轮不应移动它的任何断言 —— 若你的改动让它转红,说明你动的不是描述,**停下报告**。

**需要 changeset** —— `plugin-form` 是已发布包。

`Refs objectstack-ai/objectui#8738` —— ⛔ **不是 `Fixes`**:路 1 未裁,卡必须活下来。

⚠️ 本卡尚无 `priority:*` —— 定级归分诊席,本席 ⛔ 不代劳。

## Ruling recorded — **route 1 approved: add the named `console.warn`** (maintainer, 2026-09-09)

`domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`. Both of this card's routes are now settled:

| | route | status |
|---|---|---|
| **2** | give the registration's `fields` entry a description | ✅ **landed / in flight** — PR #8846, dispatched under objectstack#17031 |
| **1** | named `console.warn` on an unresolvable top-level `fields` member | ✅ **ruled: do it** — this comment |

⇒ The card can close once route 1 lands. PR #8846 correctly used `Refs`, ⛔ not `Fixes`, precisely so the card survived to receive this.

## What was decided, and the reasoning offered with it

The chosen option was a **named `console.warn`, same shape as `sectionFields.ts`'s existing `warnOnMixedVocabulary`** — ⛔ not a dev-build-only warning, and ⛔ not "the description is enough".

⭐ The argument that carried it, and it is the dev's own reading from PR #8846 rather than the PM's: *"the top-level `fields` path is the one surface in this file's vocabulary-mixing family that still fails silently, and a description only helps an author who reads it before writing metadata."*

⇒ The two routes are complements, not alternatives. Route 2 helps whoever **reads the authoring surface first**; route 1 helps whoever **already wrote it wrong** — today that author gets a field that simply vanishes, with no throw, no warning and no empty state.

## Scope, when dispatched

- Emit a **named** warning when a top-level `fields` member resolves to no name — the `SimpleObjectForm` loop in `ObjectForm.tsx` (`:764-778`) and `buildFlatFields` in `flatFields.ts` (`:57-65`), which is the drawer/modal path with the identical shape. ⚠️ Both, or the fix is half-done.
- **Model it on `sectionFields.ts:148`'s `warnOnMixedVocabulary`** — same voice, same once-per-occurrence discipline. ⛔ Do not invent a second warning style for the sibling surface of the one that already has one.
- The message should name **the key that was skipped** and **the difference** (`sections[].fields` accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object with identity key `field`; top-level `fields` takes bare names). A warning that says only "invalid field" reproduces the original problem in a louder voice.

## ⛔ Still forbidden — the card's own prohibition, unchanged by this ruling

> ⛔ **不要**做的:在顶层读点加一条 `?? f.field` 的宽容回退。那正是 AGENTS.md #0.1 禁止的第二方言,它会把「一个词两套词汇」固化成契约,而不是把它消掉。

⇒ **Warn, do not accept.** The ruling approves making the silent failure *audible*; it does **not** approve making the wrong spelling *work*. A dev who reads "route 1 approved" and adds a fallback has done the one thing this card names as prohibited.

## ⚠️ Two things the implementing seat inherits

1. **objectui#8847** — filed by PR #8846's dev as a sub-issue: the identical silent-drop trap exists on the **`form` / `view:form`** registration (`index.tsx:292`, same `ObjectFormRenderer`) and on **`object-master-detail-form`**'s parent `fields` (`~:430`, passed straight through to `ObjectForm`). ⚠️ **Route 1's warning lives in the shared read path, so it may cover those two surfaces for free** — the implementing seat should measure whether it does and say so, because if it does, #8847's scope shrinks to the description half.
2. **The existing probe must not move.** `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormFieldsMembers-8071.test.tsx` pins both directions with a live control (the same entry rendering correctly inside a section). Route 1 adds an observable where there was none ⇒ it should gain a pin of its own, ⛔ not alter that file's existing assertions.

Changeset required — `@object-ui/plugin-form` is published and this adds runtime output.

## Verified by content, `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx:232`

> `Bare field names to show, in order (each looked up in the object schema; `{ name }` is tolerated). NOT the same vocabulary as `sections[].fields`, which also accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object (identity key `field`, e.g. `{ field: "note", colSpan: 2 }`) — that shape resolves to no name HERE and is silently skipped (SimpleObjectForm in ObjectForm.tsx; buildFlatFields in flatFields.ts for the drawer/modal presentations).`

⇒ It names **both** vocabularies, gives the concrete wrong shape by example, says what happens to it, and names both read paths. An author reading this before writing metadata can no longer walk into the silent drop. ⭐ That is more than the route asked for and it is the right more.

The probe (`objectFormFieldsMembers-8071.test.tsx`) ran **6/6, exit 0, assertions unmoved** — the condition the dispatch set for "you changed a description and nothing else".

⚠️ **A self-caught measurement trap the dev reported rather than hid:** an early run mis-copied `--root ../..` into a repo-root invocation and silently exercised **a sibling worktree's copy of the same test file**. It noticed via the wrong worktree path in the output, discarded the reading and re-ran correctly. ⭐ A green from the wrong tree is the most dangerous kind of green, and catching it by reading the path rather than the exit code is the right instinct.

## ⭐ Route 1 is ruled — and the dev's own reading is what carried it

Asked whether route 1 was still needed after route 2 landed, the dev answered **A (yes)**, explicitly as *a reading, not something acted on*:

> `sectionFields.ts` already has `warnOnMixedVocabulary` for the sibling surface's analogous mistake; the top-level `fields` path is the one surface in this file's vocabulary-mixing family that still fails silently, and a description only helps an author who reads it before writing metadata.

The maintainer ruled the same way. ⇒ **the two routes are complements**: route 2 serves whoever reads the surface first; route 1 serves whoever already wrote it wrong.

## ⚠️ What route 1's dispatch inherits

1. **Both read paths, or it is half done** — `SimpleObjectForm` (`ObjectForm.tsx:764-778`) and `buildFlatFields` (`flatFields.ts:57-65`), the drawer/modal path with the identical shape.
2. ⛔ **Warn, do not accept.** The card's own prohibition is unchanged by the ruling: no `?? f.field` lenient fallback — that is the AGENTS.md #0.1 second dialect, and it would freeze "one word, two vocabularies" into the contract instead of removing it.
3. **objectui#8847** — filed by this round's dev: the same trap sits on the `form` / `view:form` registration (`index.tsx:292`) and on `object-master-detail-form`'s parent `fields` (`:346`). ⭐ Both confirmed by this seat on the merged tree — they are still bare `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' }` with **no description**. ⚠️ Route 1's warning lives in the shared read path, so it **may cover those two surfaces for free**; whoever implements it should measure that and say so, because if it does, #8847 shrinks to its description half.
